Sam/Karthik — quick technical note from SE side. We see two common causes: 1) corporate mail gateways that sanitize 'X-Redwood-Join' headers or replace URLs in forwarded blobs, and 2) ICS consumer apps that don't parse RFC 5545 ATTACH/URL fields consistently when organizer differs.

If you want the cleanest experience for forwarded recipients, option 1 (fresh Zoom invite sent from our A/C and created as a new calendar event) is the least likely to be stripped. I'll create a Zoom meeting (host: ben@redwood.com) and send a fresh invite to the full attendee list. That will include a standard VC URL in the LOCATION/URL fields and a plain-text copy in the body.
